# Barn 0.2.0

> Historical release record. Product names, commands, and paths have been normalized to Barn; dates, versions, results, and limitations retain their original scope. Old release downloads are no longer available. See the [current installation guide](https://barn.pgsty.com/docs/start/installation/) to install Barn.
>
> 历史发布记录：产品、命令与路径名称统一为 Barn，原始日期、版本、结果与限制保持不变。旧版发行附件已下线；安装请使用[当前指南](https://barn.pgsty.com/zh/docs/start/installation/)。


Barn 0.2.0 is a correctness and hygiene release on top of 0.1.0. It changes
how every command behaves at its boundary — under signals, in `--json`/`--yaml`
output, and when given misspelled input — and adds the gates that keep those
boundaries in place. The engine contract, the inventory format, the on-disk
state layout under `$BARN_HOME`, and the embedded image catalog
(revision `2026082903`, 9 families, 27 artifacts) are unchanged. 0.1.0
deployments continue to work without migration.

中文说明见下文。

## Highlights

- **VPN split routes no longer block a healthy lab.** A less-specific route
  such as MonoProxy's physical-interface `10.0.0.0/8` exclusion cannot beat
  Barn's owned `10.10.10.0/24`, so preflight now permits it. Equal and
  more-specific foreign routes, overlapping interfaces, occupied addresses,
  and a missing owned `/24` remain hard failures.
- **Guest host markers converge on deployment terminology.** New and
  recreated guests delete both `# barn-project-host` and
  `# barn-deployment-host` rows before writing only the deployment marker,
  so upgrading never duplicates Barn-owned `/etc/hosts` entries.
- **Selected scale-out is truly selected.** `barn up u24-1` no longer
  downloads every image named elsewhere in the inventory. Desired peers that
  have not been created are reported as `absent`; port/UUID allocation,
  stop/start/destroy, persistent-disk validation, and generated SSH/hosts
  integrations all operate on committed nodes without losing the full desired
  inventory used by later incremental `up`.
- **Clean cancellation.** `SIGINT`/`SIGTERM` cancel long-running commands
  through one context: the progress line stops, held locks are released, and
  the command exits `130` with exactly one structured result
  (`{"error":"cancelled"}`). An interrupted `up`, `recreate`, or `destroy`
  still appends its event to `events.jsonl`, so the audit trail shows what the
  signal cut short. Ctrl-C inside an SSH session stays remote.
- **`reload` is one operation.** Definition drift and removed inventory nodes
  are refused *before* any node stops, so a configuration that needs
  `recreate` or `destroy` never takes a healthy lab down; `--json` emits a
  single document instead of one per phase.
- **Misspelled nodes are refused, not executed.** `barn ssh metaa -- uptime`
  is a usage error instead of running `metaa uptime` on the control node.
  Unknown or repeated node selectors on any lifecycle command exit `2` before
  host preflight or a confirmation prompt. The ambiguous no-`--` form warns
  once; `--` remains the unambiguous and recommended remote-command boundary.
- **Confirmations are exact.** `destroy` asks for the same `destroy` token
  whether or not nodes are selected and prints the exact scope (nodes,
  persistent disks, keys, state) first. `setup` treats end of input at its
  `[Y/n]` prompt as a cancellation; only an answered prompt defaults to yes.
- **Structured output keeps its reasons.** Every failure that used to be
  written straight to stderr now reaches the `--json` payload with its
  category; presentation flags never change an exit status. Verbose
  diagnostics redact credentials and query strings from source URLs.
- **Smaller dependency graph.** Viper and its nine transitive modules are gone;
  the shipped license inventory drops from 19 modules to 9 and the binaries
  read `BARN_OUTPUT`/`BARN_VERBOSE` directly.
- **Installer retention.** `install.sh` and development builds keep at most
  three verified release directories under `.barn-releases`
  (`BARN_INSTALL_KEEP=N`, `0` disables); `current` is never touched.

## Compatibility notes

- 0.1.0 deployments remain readable without an on-disk format migration. After
  upgrading, run `barn status` while each retained VM is live so any
  pre-release process-birth identity can be rewritten from native evidence.
- A pre-0.1 development deployment whose resolved network is `user` is not a
  released format. Preserve any required disks, destroy that development
  deployment explicitly, and rebuild it on the fixed-IP network.
- Existing guests keep their current `/etc/hosts` bytes until they are
  recreated. Every 0.2 seed removes both the 0.1.0 project marker and the new
  deployment marker before writing the current rows.
- New exit code `130`: interrupted by `SIGINT`/`SIGTERM`, or a confirmation was
  declined. Scripts that checked for `2` after a mismatched `destroy` token or
  `4` after answering `no` to `setup` must accept `130`; a missing `--yes` or
  `--force` on a pipe remains `2`.
- `barn logs --source events` rejects a node argument; it is the
  deployment-wide log.
- `barn image list` help now says what the command always did: every
  architecture is listed; `info` and `pull` select the native one.
- Diagnostics say *deployment* where they used to say *project*. JSON keys and
  file names are unchanged.

## Validated boundary

The current source ran a real macOS arm64/HVF replay with MonoProxy's covering
`10.0.0.0/8` route present: selected `u24-1` creation, SSH, stop/start,
incremental cached `el9-1` creation, whole-deployment status with five absent
desired peers, both SSH connections, and full destroy/SSH-fragment cleanup all
passed. On Ubuntu 26.04 amd64/KVM, the current Linux binary audited an existing
four-node deployment as live and reached its control guest over the persisted
SSH identity without mutating that host. `make check`, the source CI, and the
packaging workflow — including race, four-target builds, installer boundaries,
SBOM/package verification, and the development archive — are green.

For contributors: `deadcode` (four-target intersection), `errcheck`, and a
maintenance-inventory check are part of `make check`; `CONTRIBUTING.md`
carries an expiry table for every pre-0.1 compatibility path.

## Start

Download the archive or native Linux package for your host from this Release.
The release `install.sh` performs a user-scoped archive install after checking
the selected asset against the `checksums.txt` generated by GitHub Actions:

```bash
chmod +x install.sh
BARN_VERSION=0.2.0 ./install.sh
barn setup --dry-run
barn setup --yes
barn up
```

Upgrading from 0.1.0 is the same command; the installer switches the `current`
link atomically and prunes older release directories beyond the retention
bound. Review the installation and privilege boundary before applying setup:
<https://barn.pgsty.com/docs/start/tutorial/>.

## Release integrity

GitHub Actions checks out the exact tag, runs the complete source gates, builds
and verifies every archive, package, and SBOM, and writes `checksums.txt` before
creating the draft Release. The application release has no separate signature
or provenance bundle; guest-image Catalog Minisign verification is unchanged.

Because 0.2.0 is below 1.0.0, the release is marked as a GitHub pre-release and
`release.json` records the `prerelease` channel; one rule decides both.

This draft must not be published until source CI, the packaging workflow, and
clean-host package consumption are confirmed.

# Barn 0.2.0（中文）

Barn 0.2.0 是在 0.1.0 之上的一个正确性与工程卫生版本。它改变的是每条命令在
边界上的行为——收到信号时、`--json`/`--yaml` 输出时、以及输入拼错时——并加入
了把这些边界守住的门禁。引擎契约、inventory 格式、`$BARN_HOME` 下的状态布局、
以及内嵌镜像目录（revision `2026082903`，9 个发行版族、27 个制品）均未变化。
0.1.0 的部署无需迁移即可继续使用。

## 亮点

- **VPN 分流父路由不再误伤健康实验环境。** MonoProxy 经物理接口排除的
  `10.0.0.0/8` 等较宽路由无法胜过 Barn 自有的 `10.10.10.0/24`，预检现在会
  放行；相同或更具体的外部路由、重叠接口、已占用地址以及自有 `/24` 缺失仍是
  硬失败。
- **Guest hosts 标记收敛到 deployment 术语。** 新建或重建的 Guest 会先删除
  `# barn-project-host` 与 `# barn-deployment-host` 两种行，再只写入新的
  deployment 标记，升级不会产生重复的 Barn `/etc/hosts` 记录。
- **选点扩容现在真正只处理选点。** `barn up u24-1` 不再下载 Inventory 中其他
  节点的镜像。尚未创建的 desired peer 会显示为 `absent`；端口/UUID 分配、
  stop/start/destroy、持久盘校验以及生成的 SSH/hosts 集成只基于 committed 节点，
  同时保留后续增量 `up` 所需的完整 desired inventory。
- **干净的取消。** `SIGINT`/`SIGTERM` 通过同一个 context 取消长时间运行的命令：
  进度行收口、已持有的锁释放、命令以 `130` 退出并且只输出一个结构化结果
  （`{"error":"cancelled"}`）。被中断的 `up`、`recreate`、`destroy` 仍会把事件写入
  `events.jsonl`，审计记录能看到信号打断了什么。SSH 会话内的 Ctrl-C 仍属于远端。
- **`reload` 是一个原子操作。** 定义漂移和被移除的节点会在**任何节点停机之前**
  被拒绝，需要 `recreate` 或 `destroy` 的配置再也不会先把健康的实验环境停掉；
  `--json` 只输出一个文档，而不是每个阶段一个。
- **拼错的节点名被拒绝，而不是被执行。** `barn ssh metaa -- uptime` 现在是用法
  错误，而不是在控制节点上执行 `metaa uptime`。任何生命周期命令上未知或重复的
  节点选择器都会在宿主预检或确认提示之前以 `2` 退出。不带 `--` 的歧义写法会警告
  一次；`--` 仍是无歧义且推荐的远程命令边界。
- **确认是精确的。** `destroy` 无论是否选择了节点都要求输入同一个 `destroy`，并
  先打印确切的影响范围（节点、持久磁盘、密钥、状态）。`setup` 把 `[Y/n]` 提示处的
  输入结束（Ctrl-D）视为取消；只有真正回答过的提示才默认为 yes。
- **结构化输出保留原因。** 以前直接写到 stderr 的失败现在都会带着分类进入
  `--json` 载荷；展示类 flag 永远不改变退出码。verbose 诊断会脱敏源 URL 中的
  凭据和查询串。
- **更小的依赖图。** 移除了 Viper 及其 9 个传递依赖；随包发布的许可证清单从
  19 个模块减到 9 个，二进制直接读取 `BARN_OUTPUT`/`BARN_VERBOSE`。
- **安装器保留策略。** `install.sh` 与开发构建在 `.barn-releases` 下最多保留
  三份已验证的发布目录（`BARN_INSTALL_KEEP=N`，`0` 关闭）；`current` 指向的
  目录永远不会被动。

## 兼容性说明

- 0.1.0 deployment 无需磁盘状态格式迁移即可继续读取。升级后请在每台保留 VM
  在线时运行一次 `barn status`，让任何发布前进程出生身份根据原生证据完成重写。
- resolved network 为 `user` 的 0.1 之前开发 deployment 从未成为正式格式；请先
  保留需要的数据盘，再显式销毁该开发 deployment，并用固定 IP 网络重建。
- 现有 Guest 在重建前会保留当前 `/etc/hosts`；所有 0.2 seed 都会同时删除 0.1.0
  的 project 标记和新的 deployment 标记，再写入当前记录。
- 新增退出码 `130`：被 `SIGINT`/`SIGTERM` 中断，或确认被拒绝。之前在 `destroy`
  token 不匹配时检查 `2`、或在 `setup` 回答 no 时检查 `4` 的脚本需要接受 `130`；
  管道下缺少 `--yes` 或 `--force` 仍然是 `2`。
- `barn logs --source events` 不再接受节点参数；它是部署级日志。
- `barn image list` 的帮助文本改为如实描述：该命令一直列出所有架构；`info`
  与 `pull` 选择本机架构。
- 诊断信息中原来的 *project* 一律改为 *deployment*。JSON 键与文件名未变。

## 验证边界

当前源码在 MonoProxy 的 `10.0.0.0/8` 覆盖路由存在时完成了真实 macOS arm64/HVF
Replay：选点创建 `u24-1`、SSH、stop/start、增量创建已缓存的 `el9-1`、含五个
absent desired peer 的 whole status、两台 SSH，以及 whole destroy/SSH fragment 清理
全部通过。在 Ubuntu 26.04 amd64/KVM 上，当前 Linux 二进制无变更地审计了一套现存
四节点 deployment，并通过持久化 SSH 身份进入控制 Guest。`make check`、源码 CI 与
打包工作流均为绿色，覆盖 race、四平台构建、安装器边界、SBOM/Package 校验和开发归档。

面向贡献者：`deadcode`（四平台交集）、`errcheck` 和维护清单检查已进入
`make check`；`CONTRIBUTING.md` 为每条 0.1 之前的兼容路径记录了到期表。

## 开始使用

从本 Release 下载对应宿主的归档或 Linux 原生软件包。随发布提供的 `install.sh`
会在核对 GitHub Actions 生成的 `checksums.txt` 后做用户级归档安装：

```bash
chmod +x install.sh
BARN_VERSION=0.2.0 ./install.sh
barn setup --dry-run
barn setup --yes
barn up
```

从 0.1.0 升级使用同一条命令；安装器原子切换 `current` 链接，并按保留上限清理更
旧的发布目录。应用 setup 前请先阅读安装与权限边界说明：
<https://barn.pgsty.com/docs/start/tutorial/>。

## 发布完整性

GitHub Actions 检出准确 Tag，运行完整源码门禁，构建并验证所有 Archive、Package 与
SBOM，再生成 `checksums.txt` 并创建 Draft Release。应用发布不再附加签名或
Provenance Bundle；Guest 镜像 Catalog 的 Minisign 校验保持不变。

由于 0.2.0 低于 1.0.0，本发布标记为 GitHub 预发布，`release.json` 记录
`prerelease` 通道；两者由同一条规则决定。

在源码 CI、打包工作流和干净宿主上的软件包安装确认之前，此草稿不得发布。
